about: Research sheet for the Alaska borough and census area edition. Every contact below was read on the date in reviewed_on from the page named beside it; scripts/make_county_state.py turns it into the edition files.
name: Alaska
phones_sentence: Veteran Service Officer phones come from the Office of Veterans Affairs. Boroughs and census areas without a listed service officer show the office’s statewide line.

offices.source_title: Alaska Office of Veterans Affairs: Veteran Service Officers
offices.note: Veteran Service Officers give free benefit counseling and claims help; you do not need to belong to their organization.
offices.selection: Alaska has no county or borough veterans offices. The Office of Veterans Affairs page (read in full) lists service officers by location with phones but no street addresses. Each location is shown for the borough it sits in (Craig / Ketchikan Gateway for both Ketchikan Gateway Borough and Prince of Wales-Hyder Census Area); the other 22 boroughs and census areas show the office’s statewide line.

aging.source_title: Alaska Division of Senior and Disabilities Services: Aging and Disability Resource Centers
aging.source_scope: Each regional ADRC’s service area, agency, address and phone, and the statewide number 1-855-565-2017; read in full; undated. Borough and census area assignments follow the page’s service-area names; see each card.
aging.description: Alaska’s Aging and Disability Resource Centers connect seniors, people with disabilities and caregivers with long-term services and supports, regardless of age or income, through regional offices. Specialists pre-screen in person, at home, by phone or by video.
aging.next_step_extra: The statewide ADRC number, 1-855-565-2017, also reaches a specialist.

programs.name: Alaska veterans: Office of Veterans Affairs and Veteran Service Officers
programs.organization: Alaska Department of Military and Veterans Affairs, Office of Veterans Affairs
programs.description: The Office of Veterans Affairs works with four veterans organizations (Veterans of Foreign Wars, American Legion, Disabled American Veterans and Vietnam Veterans of America) to provide Veteran Service Officers for free benefit counseling and claims help, in Anchorage, Wasilla, Juneau, Fairbanks, Soldotna, Kodiak and Craig / Ketchikan Gateway.
programs.next_step: Choose a borough or census area above for its service officer, or call the Office of Veterans Affairs at 907-334-0874 or 888-248-3682.
constraints: The state lists service officers by phone only; call before visiting.

sources.title: Alaska Office of Veterans Affairs: Veteran Service Officers
sources.scope: Service officers by location with phones, the Office of Veterans Affairs address and phones, and the Tribal Veteran Representatives list; read in full.

sources.title: Alaska Office of Veterans Affairs: Veterans Benefits 2025
sources.scope: The same service officer locations and the office’s address and phones; read in full.

programs.name: Alaska Aging and Disability Resource Centers
programs.organization: Alaska Division of Senior and Disabilities Services and regional ADRC partners
programs.description: Regional Aging and Disability Resource Centers connect seniors, people with disabilities and caregivers with long-term services and supports, regardless of age or income. Military service is not required.
programs.next_step: Call 1-855-565-2017, or choose a borough or census area above for its regional ADRC.
constraints: Each program has its own eligibility and waitlist.

sources.title: Alaska Division of Senior and Disabilities Services: Aging and Disability Resource Centers
sources.scope: Statewide number and regional offices; read in full.

programs.name: Medicare counseling (Alaska Medicare Information Office, SHIP)
programs.organization: Alaska Division of Senior and Disabilities Services, Medicare Information Office (SHIP)
programs.description: Free Medicare counseling from Alaska’s State Health Insurance Assistance Program, the Medicare Information Office.
programs.next_step: Call 1-800-478-6065 (toll-free within Alaska) or 907-269-3680. The Anchorage office is by appointment only. For Medicare itself, call 800-MEDICARE (800-633-4227).
constraints: Counseling is by appointment. Have your Medicare card and drug list ready.

sources.title: University of Alaska Anchorage: Alaska Resource Guide (April 2024)
sources.scope: Medicare Information Office, Anchorage office by appointment only; (907) 269-3680, toll-free within Alaska 1-800-478-6065; search excerpt.

sources.title: AARP: Family caregiver resources for Alaska
sources.scope: Medicare Information Office and SHIP, 800-478-6065 or 907-269-3680; search excerpt.

programs.name: Alaska Long Term Care Ombudsman and adult abuse reporting
programs.organization: Alaska Office of the Long Term Care Ombudsman; Division of Senior and Disabilities Services, Adult Protective Services
programs.description: Advocacy for older Alaskans in nursing homes and assisted living, including discharge concerns and complaints. Adult Protective Services takes reports of harm to vulnerable adults.
programs.next_step: Call the ombudsman at 907-334-4480 or 800-730-6393. To report harm to a vulnerable adult, call Adult Protective Services at 1-800-478-9996 (in Alaska) or 907-269-3666, or report online. In an emergency, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing agency.

sources.title: Alaska Long Term Care Ombudsman brochure
sources.scope: Office address, phones and email; search excerpt.

sources.title: Alaska DSDS: Adult Protective Services
sources.scope: Report suspected abuse of a vulnerable adult at 1-800-478-9996; 907-269-3666; search excerpt.

sources.title: Alaska Department of Health: Report harm to Adult Protective Services
sources.scope: Online report form; call 1-800-478-9996 in Alaska or 907-269-3666; search excerpt.

programs.name: Free legal help for older Alaskans
programs.organization: Alaska Legal Services Corporation, Elder Law Project
programs.description: Alaska Legal Services Corporation’s Elder Law Project gives free civil legal help to Alaskans 60 and older, without regard to income, with priority for seniors in social or economic need. ALSC serves every community through statewide offices.
programs.next_step: Apply online at alsc-law.org or call the statewide intake line, 1-888-478-2572.
constraints: Intake can take up to two business days; if the line is busy, apply online or call the nearest ALSC office.

sources.title: Alaska Legal Services Corporation: Elder Law Project
sources.scope: Legal aid for Alaskans 60 and older without regard to income, priority for social or economic need; search excerpt.

sources.title: Alaska Legal Services Corporation: Apply for help
sources.scope: Apply online or call toll-free 1-888-478-2572; search excerpt.

programs.name: VA health care in Alaska
programs.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, VA Alaska Healthcare System
programs.description: Alaska veterans are served by the VA Alaska Healthcare System: the Anchorage VA Medical Center (1201 North Muldoon Road) and clinics in Fairbanks, Kenai, Mat-Su and Juneau. VA also pays for some care from tribal and community providers.
programs.next_step: Call 888-353-7574 for appointments; after hours, ask the operator for the administrator on duty. Not enrolled yet? Ask a Veteran Service Officer for help applying.
constraints: If a service you need is not offered near you, ask about travel benefits and community care.

sources.title: VA Alaska health care: Contact us
sources.scope: Anchorage VA Medical Center, 1201 North Muldoon Road; toll-free 888-353-7574; search excerpt.

coverage_scope: Referral edition. All 30 boroughs and census areas show a Veteran Service Officer (8) or the Office of Veterans Affairs line, their regional Aging and Disability Resource Center, the statewide long-term care ombudsman and a Center for Independent Living.
coverage_note: Veteran Service Officers come from the Office of Veterans Affairs. ADRCs come from the Division of Senior and Disabilities Services. Centers for Independent Living come from the ILRU national directory. Reviewed November 16, 2026. Contacts are not telephone-confirmed.
